name: ELSA
recent: ELSA 在 2026 财年第三季度转亏为盈，录得 RM3.6 million 税后利润，主要受机器人及数字解决方案业务带动。公司近期出现多项高层人事变动，包括董事、审计委员会、风险委员会及提名与薪酬委员会成员更替，以及公司秘书变更。此外，一名大股东在 10 月增持股份，而管理层在 10 月表明将在闭市期交易。
notable: 2026 财年第三季度转亏为盈，录得 RM3.6 million 税后利润。
董事总经理 Daniel Ilham Khong 于 10 月 1 日以每股 RM0.230 增持 500 万股。
多名董事及委员会成员出现变动，包括 Dr Azuraida Binti Shahadan 的董事会及委员会职务。
risks: 管理层及董事在闭市期前表明有意进行股票交易。
大股东 Chow Sheng Jon 的持股出现变动。

recent_en: ELSA returned to profitability in 3Q26 with RM3.6 million PAT, driven by stronger robotics and digital solutions. The company saw several senior personnel changes, including board, audit, risk, nomination and remuneration committee changes, and a change of company secretary. A substantial shareholder increased his stake in October, while management indicated intended dealings during the closed period.
notable_en: Returned to profit in 3Q26 with RM3.6 million PAT.
Managing Director Daniel Ilham Khong acquired 5 million shares at RM0.230 per share on 1 October.
Several board and committee changes, including Dr Azuraida Binti Shahadan's board and committee roles.
risks_en: Management and directors indicated intention to deal in shares ahead of the closed period.
Substantial shareholder Chow Sheng Jon's shareholding changed.
